prompt: Photoreal cinematic practical-effects footage. Preserve the reference video continuous movement and transforming boat geometry. A recognisable ivory folded paper boat floats in living water on a dark timber workbench. Its central paper fold stretches and billows into woven cream canvas sails, its folded hull continuously curves into polished dark mahogany. Real brass rigging and timber deck details emerge. The camera smoothly retreats as the reflecting pool expands into an open blue ocean under warm sunrise. The one boat becomes a full-size twelve-meter sailing yacht, riding natural waves. Lifelike paper fibres, wet timber grain, rope, dynamic reflections, bow spray, salt mist and sunlight. One continuous physical material and scale transformation, no edit.
